stories.title: Initialize Rust CLI project structure
stories.description: Create Cargo.toml, src/main.rs, src/lib.rs, and base module directories. Set up workspace with clap, tokio, serde, anyhow, thiserror, tracing, and other core dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Cargo.toml exists with correct metadata and dependencies
src/main.rs prints hello world via lib
Directory structure for cli, config, router, providers, memory, context, tasks, review, approvals, prompts, utils exists

stories.title: Add clap CLI shell with all MVP commands
stories.description: Implement clap derive-based CLI with subcommands: init, config, scan, context, route, plan, execute, review, memory, run, status. Include --dry-run, --config, --json flags. Ensure --help output is useful.

stories.title: Add typed config schema and loader
stories.description: Create Config struct with serde_yaml support. Define schema for project, execution, models, routing, context, memory sections. Implement config loader with env var substitution and helpful validation errors.
acceptance_criteria: Env var substitution works for secrets

stories.title: Implement orca init
stories.description: Implement the init command to create .orca/ directory structure, default config, state.json, memory directories, graph directories, and context-packets directory.
acceptance_criteria: orca init creates memory, graph, context-packets subdirs
orca init is idempotent (safe to run twice)

stories.title: Implement config validation and orca config validate
stories.description: Implement config validation logic and wire it to the config validate CLI command. Validate required paths, provider settings, and env var presence where configured.
acceptance_criteria: orca config validate passes for valid config
orca config validate fails with clear error for invalid config
Validation catches missing provider model IDs when provider is enabled
Tests cover valid and invalid configs

stories.title: Implement provider traits and shared types
stories.description: Define Provider trait, ProviderKind enum, ProviderCapability enum, ProviderRequest, ProviderResponse, CostEstimate, and ProviderError. Use thiserror for error variants.
acceptance_criteria: Provider trait is defined with async methods
ProviderKind enum covers all MVP providers

stories.title: Implement mock provider
stories.description: Create a mock provider adapter that implements the Provider trait. It should return deterministic responses for testing, work without API keys, and support dry-run mode.
acceptance_criteria: Mock provider works without any env vars

stories.title: Implement routing policy and decision types
stories.description: Create routing policy config, RoutingDecision struct, and the core router logic. Router should consider task type, complexity, risk, file count, previous failures, budget policy, and provider availability.
acceptance_criteria: RoutingDecision struct exists with provider, model, reason, approval_required
Router selects Cursor Composer for repo-aware tasks
Router selects Codex for scoped exact tasks
Router considers failure count for escalation

stories.title: Implement orca route
stories.description: Wire the router to the CLI. Implement orca route <TASK-ID> that reads task metadata, runs the router, and prints a human-readable recommendation. Support --json output.
acceptance_criteria: orca route TASK-001 prints provider recommendation
Command fails gracefully for unknown task IDs

stories.title: Implement memory store and safe file writing
stories.description: Create a file-based memory store that safely writes markdown notes under .orca/memory/. Include atomic writes, directory creation, and read helpers.

stories.title: Implement Obsidian-compatible note writer
stories.description: Extend memory store to write Obsidian-compatible markdown notes with YAML frontmatter. Support task notes, decision notes, and standard vault pages.
acceptance_criteria: Task notes have correct frontmatter fields

stories.title: Implement lightweight graph memory model
stories.description: Create Node and Edge types, graph storage as JSON under .orca/graph/, and helpers to add/query graph relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Graph nodes have id, kind, label, metadata
Graph edges have source, target, kind, metadata
Graph writes to nodes.json and edges.json
Graph can be loaded back from JSON

stories.title: Implement context packet schema and renderer
stories.description: Define ContextPacket struct with all required fields. Implement markdown and JSON rendering. Include validation that required fields are present.
acceptance_criteria: ContextPacket struct has all MVP fields

stories.title: Implement orca context
stories.description: Wire context packet generation to CLI. Implement orca context <TASK-ID> that reads task and memory, builds a context packet, and writes it to .orca/context-packets/.
acceptance_criteria: orca context TASK-001 writes a context packet file
Context packet includes relevant project memory
Command fails gracefully for unknown task IDs

stories.title: Implement repo scanning and orca scan
stories.description: Implement a repo scanner that walks the project directory, builds a file summary, detects project type, and updates project memory with findings.
acceptance_criteria: orca scan walks repo and finds files

stories.title: Implement task model and task lifecycle
stories.description: Create Task struct with id, title, description, type, complexity, risk, status, acceptance criteria, etc. Implement status transitions and validation.
acceptance_criteria: Task struct has all MVP fields
Task status enum covers lifecycle states

stories.title: Implement dry-run execution and orca execute
stories.description: Implement execution flow that supports dry-run mode. Wire to orca execute --dry-run <TASK-ID>. In dry-run, print what would happen without calling real providers.
acceptance_criteria: orca execute --dry-run TASK-001 prints execution plan
Dry-run does not require API keys
Command shows provider, model, and estimated cost

stories.title: Implement review schema and orca review
stories.description: Create ReviewResult struct with accepted, reasons, missing criteria, risks, recommended next step. Wire to orca review <TASK-ID> with mock review in MVP.
acceptance_criteria: ReviewResult struct has all MVP fields
orca review TASK-001 outputs review result
Review can accept, reject, or recommend escalation
Review considers acceptance criteria from task

stories.title: Implement memory update flow and orca memory update
stories.description: Implement memory update proposal generation and safe application. Wire to orca memory update <TASK-ID>. Update task history, current state, and model performance.
acceptance_criteria: orca memory update TASK-001 updates memory files
Memory update appends to task history
Memory update is safe (atomic write, backup)

stories.title: Implement approval gates
stories.description: Create approval gate system that checks if a task requires manual approval. Gates for premium providers, destructive operations, and high-risk tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Approval gate blocks premium Cursor without approval
Approval gate blocks destructive fs ops without approval
Approval gate can be bypassed with --yes flag
Config controls which gates are enabled

stories.title: Implement provider adapter skeletons
stories.description: Create placeholder/stub implementations for Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI/Codex, Cursor, and Command providers. Each should implement Provider trait with clear TODOs for real integration. Cursor adapter must not require Node.js.
acceptance_criteria: All MVP provider kinds have adapter structs
Cursor adapter is a safe placeholder
Ollama adapter has HTTP client skeleton
Anthropic adapter has HTTP client skeleton
OpenAI/Codex adapter has HTTP client skeleton

stories.title: Implement orca plan
stories.description: Implement plan command that generates a task graph from project memory and plan input. Support --manual mode. Write task-graph.yaml.

stories.title: Implement orca run --dry-run orchestration
stories.description: Implement run command that orchestrates the full loop: context -> route -> execute -> review -> memory update, all in dry-run mode.
acceptance_criteria: orca run --dry-run TASK-001 runs full loop
Each step prints what it would do
Loop stops early if a step fails

stories.title: Implement orca status
stories.description: Implement status command that reads state and task graph, then prints a summary of project health, completed tasks, pending tasks, and blocked tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Shows completed, pending, and blocked task counts

stories.title: Add prompt library
stories.description: Create src/prompts/library.rs with all required prompt constants: Project Memory Agent, Context Packet Agent, Router Agent, Claude Planner Agent, Cursor Composer Execution Agent, Codex Scoped Executor, Ollama Compression Agent, Review Agent.
acceptance_criteria: All MVP prompts exist as Rust constants
Prompt tests verify presence and non-empty

stories.title: Add secret redaction utilities
stories.description: Implement utilities to redact secrets from strings before logging or including in context packets. Redact API keys, tokens, .env contents, private keys.

stories.title: Add integration-style tests for full dry-run workflow
stories.description: Create integration tests that exercise the full dry-run workflow using a temporary project fixture. Use assert_cmd and tempfile.
acceptance_criteria: Integration test runs orca init in temp dir
Integration test runs orca config validate
Integration test runs orca memory update

stories.title: Add documentation
stories.description: Create README.md, docs/getting-started.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/model-routing.md, docs/memory-system.md, docs/providers.md, docs/ralph-development-workflow.md, docs/cursor-integration.md.

stories.title: Final polish and README verification
stories.description: Final pass: ensure all quality commands pass, orca --help works, all docs are accurate, and the project is ready for distribution. Update prd.json and progress.txt.
acceptance_criteria: All stories marked passing in prd.json

stories.title: Fix MVP routing policy for planning tasks
stories.description: Separate Planning from Architecture/Decomposition/RiskAnalysis routing. Add ProviderKind::Manual and model enabled flags. Route planning tasks to Ollama (low risk), default planner (medium), or Claude (high complexity), with Manual fallback. Fix task graph resolution so route/context/execute/review/run commands load real task metadata from .orca/task-graph.yaml instead of synthesizing defaults. Missing task IDs now fail with clear error instead of silent fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Planning tasks route separately from Architecture
Planning reasons do not mention implementation
route.rs defaults to Planning task type
route/context/execute/review/run resolve tasks from task graph
Missing task IDs fail with clear error, not silent fallback

stories.title: Reject missing explicit task IDs instead of fallback tasks
stories.description: Explicit task IDs not found in .orca/task-graph.yaml were silently converted to fallback Planning tasks. Commands now return a clear error with non-zero exit code. No files are written. No routing decisions are produced.
acceptance_criteria: route TASK-999 fails with error mentioning task-graph.yaml
Missing IDs do not create context packets
Missing IDs do not modify state.json
Existing valid IDs still work after plan generation

stories.title: Fix --json output flag
stories.description: The --json flag was defined globally but silently ignored by most commands. Removed it from global scope, added proper JSON output to route and run, and kept status as-is. Unsupported commands now fail with a clear clap error when --json is passed.
acceptance_criteria: init --json fails with unexpected argument error
review --json fails with unexpected argument error
execute --json fails with unexpected argument error
JSON output does not contain human-readable headings

stories.title: Add real OpenAI-compatible provider execution
stories.description: Implement real HTTP execution for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (local llama.cpp server, etc.) using the existing provider abstraction. Add config-driven OpenAiModelConfig with base_url, api_key_env_var, timeout, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens. Implement provider factory to instantiate correct provider from routing decision. Wire execute and run commands to use factory. Preserve mock provider and dry-run behavior. Add wiremock tests for request shape, response parsing, HTTP errors, auth errors, timeouts. Ensure secrets are redacted in errors.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAiProvider executes real HTTP calls to /v1/chat/completions
Config schema includes OpenAiModelConfig with all required fields
Provider factory creates correct provider from routing decision
execute.rs uses factory instead of hardcoded MockProvider
run.rs uses factory for real execution
Dry-run performs zero provider HTTP calls
Provider handles HTTP errors with clear messages
Secrets are redacted in error messages
Config backward compatibility: missing openai section parses with defaults

stories.title: Add provider execution safety controls
stories.description: Add timeout handling, retry policy with backoff for transient failures, max request size guard (max_input_tokens), max response size guard (max_response_bytes), and provider call metadata capture (duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens) in ProviderResponse. Update all provider skeletons to support new response fields. Add wiremock tests for retries, oversized input rejection, oversized response rejection, and metadata presence.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAiProvider retries transient errors (5xx, timeout, rate limit)
Oversized input is rejected before HTTP call
Oversized response is rejected before parsing
All provider skeletons compile with new response fields
